scope: Reviewed corrections that scripts/research/build-party-links.py applies on top of its automatic matching. "aliases": extra Hebrew Wikipedia title aliases valid only in the named election. "overlayReviewedAt": an election whose overlay was re-reviewed after 2026-11-04. "entries": the links and/or gap reasons of one list or constituent, replacing what the rules compute (links first; gaps must then name exactly the missing kinds). The build fails if an entry no longer changes anything. Each item gives its reason and source (commit and audit record).
